$comment: Machine state for the Occestra x GenLayer build. scripts/genlayer.mjs reads and writes this. Never hand-edit `status` without also running `node scripts/genlayer.mjs guard`.
mission: Add GenLayer Bradbury as Occestra's independent quality-adjudication layer. Occestra Tribunal = fast first-instance grading. GenLayer = independent appellate consensus. X Layer = payment + provenance. These three never collapse into each other.

phases.title: Audit + align the GenLayer foundation with the real SDK
phases.commitMessage: fix(genlayer): align consensus adjudicator with current sdk
acceptance: genlayer python venv installs from pinned, mutually-compatible releases
genvm-lint check passes with zero warnings on the adjudicator
every gl.* call in the contract is verified against the installed SDK source, not docs memory
direct tests run offline with web + LLM mocked

direct tests cover: local PASS upheld, PASS overturned, FAIL upheld, FAIL overturned, undetermined, malformed evidence, artifact hash mismatch, wrong evidence origin, publicForConsensus=false, unsupported profile, invalid OQS version, duplicate review id, unavailable evidence, visual/written/plan review
consensus compares stable fields (decision, scoreBand, criticalFailure, normalized failureCodes) — never free-form prose
npm run check stays green
no unrelated existing test was weakened to go green

phases.title: packages/genlayer — Bradbury client + evidence schemas
phases.commitMessage: feat(genlayer): add Bradbury client and evidence schemas
acceptance: all GenLayer network behaviour is encapsulated in @occestra/genlayer; no genlayer-js import leaks into studio-core or mcp-server logic
Zod schemas for ConsensusDecision / ConsensusStatus / ConsensusProfile / ConsensusReview / EvidenceSnapshot
canonical evidence hashing reuses Occestra's existing deterministic key-ordering discipline
isGenLayerConfigured / buildEvidenceSnapshot / hashEvidenceSnapshot / submitConsensusReview / getConsensusReview / waitForConsensusAccepted / waitForConsensusFinalized
missing GenLayer config gracefully disables submission and never crashes Occestra
GENLAYER_SUBMITTER_PRIVATE_KEY is server-only and never NEXT_PUBLIC_*
mocked tests for config, evidence construction, hashing, submission mapping, status normalization
root build/test pipeline includes @occestra/genlayer in dependency order
no HTTP routes or UI in this phase

phases.title: Immutable evidence endpoints + consensus_reviews persistence
phases.commitMessage: feat(consensus): add immutable GenLayer evidence snapshots
acceptance: consensus_reviews table added via the existing store migration style — no second database
GET /genlayer/evidence/:reviewId returns the exact frozen snapshot, byte-stable across calls
GET /genlayer/artifacts/:reviewId serves a frozen public consensus asset, never a private storage path
GET /genlayer/reviews/:reviewId returns review state
evidence_json / evidence_hash / artifact_hash / local_verdict can never be replaced after creation
server builds evidence from stored artifact + Tribunal result + OQS rubric + explicit consent; never accepts client-supplied evidence JSON
artifact hash is validated against actual stored bytes before freezing
publicForConsensus=false is refused before any snapshot exists
tests prove no private field (owner token, salt, email, signed URL, api key) leaks into a snapshot
no blockchain submission in this phase

phases.title: Durable job submission to GenLayer
phases.commitMessage: feat(consensus): connect Tribunal reviews to GenLayer
acceptance: lifecycle NOT_REQUESTED -> QUEUED -> SUBMITTED -> ACCEPTED -> FINALIZED, with FAILED as terminal
reuses packages/mcp-server/src/jobs.ts; no new queue subsystem
retries never create a second on-chain review for the same reviewId
an existing tx hash resumes polling instead of resubmitting
temporary RPC failure retries; contract revert is terminal FAILED
raw wallet/provider errors stay in logs; public responses carry sanitized error codes only
X Layer sealer key and GenLayer submitter key remain separate credentials
POST /genlayer/reviews returns 202 with reviewId + QUEUED
MCP oce_consensus_review returns identifiers and does not block on finalization
tests: upheld, overturned, undetermined, RPC outage, revert, resume from SUBMITTED, resume from ACCEPTED, duplicate HTTP request, duplicate worker run, private artifact refused
notes: DEVIATION from the spec's 'reuse jobs.ts': jobs.ts recovery REQUEUES AND RE-RUNS anything that was 'running' at restart (deliberate — the buyer paid, so we eat the provider cost twice). For a consensus review that behaviour is actively wrong: re-running a SUBMITTED review would submit a SECOND on-chain transaction. consensus_reviews.status is already a durable state machine with transaction_hash for resumption, so the worker drives off that table instead. No second database, no new queue table — the intent of the rule is kept, the mechanism is not.

phases.title: Overturn -> bounded repair, with preserved history
phases.commitMessage: feat(consensus): route overturned reviews into bounded repair
acceptance: a GenLayer verdict never mutates a historical local Tribunal report
repair produces a NEW artifact version with explicit repairedFrom lineage
only normalized fields (decision, criticalFailure, failureCodes, score band) reach the repair brief — never validator prose
at most 1 automatic consensus-triggered repair; further review requires explicit request
an UPHELD local FAIL does not trigger pointless regeneration
lineage is exposed in the domain model and API
tests prove history preservation

phases.title: Public consensus UI in Amethyst Daylight
acceptance: /consensus explains the CREATE-GRADE / ADJUDICATE / PROVE trust split
restrained consensus panel on public pack/artifact pages covering all 7 states
shows network, contract address, review id, tx/explorer link, OQS version, local verdict, decision, failure codes, artifact version, timestamps
no raw chain/provider errors surfaced
Remember: the ask button is absent unless the artifact is explicitly published
FAILED state makes no claim of verification
accessibility + reduced-motion honoured
Playwright screenshots inspected across desktop/tablet/mobile x Daylight/Nocturne
no crypto-dashboard redesign; no loud GenLayer branding

phases.title: Bradbury deployment + real smoke reviews
phases.commitMessage: feat(genlayer): deploy quality adjudicator to Bradbury
acceptance: GATE: every local test green, no secrets in git, dedicated funded GenLayer wallet, X Layer production keys untouched
deployed with a wallet that is NOT the sealer, treasury, or X Layer deployer
records network, chain id, address, deploy tx, deployer address, timestamp, explorer URL, SDK versions
three real smoke reviews: strong public visual, deliberately weak public visual, written artifact
each smoke review is frozen, submitted, finalized, read back from chain, persisted, and matches what the UI/API display
unexpected behaviour is documented, never fabricated into a clean result
blockers: requires owner confirmation of the funded Bradbury wallet
notes: Submitter/deployer wallet 0x2C0DD61f5a4f1d5a7BAff79362641AfB6fBA3342, key in /root/.occestra-secrets/genlayer.env (chmod 600, separate file from occestra.env). Funding ask: 10 GEN. Live fee data 2026-09-03: baseFee 0.119 gwei, SDK adds flat 2 gwei priority -> ~2.12 gwei effective; ~0.064 GEN per tx at a pessimistic 30M gas; deploy + 3 smoke + 30 benchmark + 10 retries = ~2.8 GEN.
AWAITING OWNER: wallet must be funded before any deploy. Verify balance with eth_getBalance before P7 starts.

phases.title: Honest benchmark corpus + GENLAYER-EVALUATION.md
acceptance: 20-30 synthetic/public artifacts across visual, written, plan — no private customer material
per-case record of expected issue, local verdict, axis results, GenLayer decision, band, codes, agreement, latency, tx hash, finalization
agreement rate, overturn rate, undetermined rate, catch rate, median + p95 latency, false positives/negatives caught
no claim of statistical significance from a small sample
honest examples where GenLayer improved, agreed, was uncertain, and surprised us
/consensus exposes only real aggregate counts — no seeded numbers

phases.title: Builder submission polish
phases.commitMessage: docs(genlayer): prepare consensus review for builder submission
acceptance: a steward who has never seen Occestra understands the 10 required points in five minutes
README carries the GenLayer section with real address, explorer, source path, test path, live URL, real finalized review, benchmark link
architecture artwork updated
90-second demo guide present
git grep finds no TODO / PLACEHOLDER / YOUR_ / 0x000000 in shipped GenLayer surface
no stale OQS versions, no wrong chain ids, no fixtures presented as production
npm run check green; genvm lint + direct tests green
not merged to main

allowedProtectedEdits.reason: adds oce_consensus_review: 0 only. A tool absent from PRICES is answered 404 at the paywall, so registering the MCP tool without a price entry would make it unreachable. No existing price, and no payment logic, is touched.
